title: HB1579 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 4, Chapter 54; Section 36-3-625; Section 38-3-119; Title 39 and Section 40-14-109, relative to restricting certain types of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-04-12; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2777210)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2023-04-12). The caption lists other code sections (4-54, 36-3-625, 38-3-119, 40-14-109) but the text read has only the new Title 39 section and effective date.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new section, TCA Title 39, Ch. 17, Pt. 13): (A) "Assault weapon" means any of the following:
SECTION 1 (new section, TCA Title 39, Ch. 17, Pt. 13(b)): (1) Notwithstanding a law to the contrary, it is an offense for a person to: (A) Purchase or attempt to purchase an assault weapon; or (B) Sell or offer to sell an assault weapon to a person.
SECTION 1 (new section, TCA Title 39, Ch. 17, Pt. 13(b)): (2) A violation of this subsection (b) is a Class A misdemeanor.
